vb_textbox.text: Hello - I believe that the gnomes colours will have weight attached to them - red is better than brown, brown is better than green etc. However I could not work out the exact pattern. I believe that Green was always better than red and brown would always be higher than purple. I hope that helps - try to take notice of patterns, it may also depend on the side of the screen the gnomes appear on. Good luck, we need many mushrooms
